runners.breeder: Exors Of The Late John Harrington

runners.comment: Made the breakthrough at Perth in October but he's been well held in both runs since
runners.name: Diamond Geezer
runners.spotlight: Came good in first-time cheekpieces at Perth (2m4f, soft; front pair clear) in October, but he's been well held in both subsequent runs (2m3f/2m7f); still lightly raced but has bit to prove again and he needs to rediscover his spark.

runners.comment: Veteran whose sole win was in 2020 and he's been well held in three runs for current yard

runners.comment: Showed progressive form in novice events and he should have more to offer in handicaps
runners.name: Rock Dj

runners.spotlight: Runner-up in his final Irish point and he showed progressive form in three novice hurdles in the autumn; was only beaten around 4l at Wetherby (2m3f, soft) last time and he should have more to offer on this switch to handicapping; one to keep an eye on.

runners.comment: Won over C&D in 2023 but he's not seen much action since and others are preferred
runners.name: Langdale Lane
runners.spotlight: Won a C&D maiden (good to soft) in February 2023 but he's had only five runs since and has been well held in last three completed starts; unseated over fences here last month and has plenty to prove back in this sphere.

runners.comment: Six-time hurdle winner but he didn't fire last time and has never won over this far
runners.name: El Jefe
runners.spotlight: Six-time hurdle winner who was a good second at Haydock (2m3f, soft) on his penultimate run; looks interesting on that form but he didn't fire in a small field at Uttoxeter on Saturday and he's never won over this far; mixed messages.

runners.comment: Won by 7l at Carlisle last month and he had an excuse over 3m last time; possibilities
runners.name: Fostered Phil
runners.spotlight: 12yo who scored at Perth (2m4f, good) in September and was a 7l winner at Carlisle (2m1f, soft) last month; only fifth of ten here last time but that was an experiment over 3m and he still looks on a workable mark; dangerous dropped back in trip and grade.

runners.comment: No progress since joining current yard and she's now 0-7 in handicaps; down the list
runners.name: Jakana
runners.spotlight: Runner-up at Hexham (2m4f, good) on stable debut in June but that was a four-runner race and she's hasn't kicked on since then; mark continues to fall but she's now 0-7 in handicaps and others are more convincing.

runners.comment: Absent since pulled up in November 2024; this 10yo faces a very tough task on his return
runners.name: Donny Boy
runners.spotlight: Point, bumper and maiden hurdle winner who ran well in two handicap chases here in 2024; however, this 10yo has been absent since being pulled up at Newbury that November and faces a very tough assignment on his return.

runners.comment: Showed last month he retains a good chunk of his ability; the likely danger to Wendigo
runners.name: Maximilian
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in Grade 1 novice hurdle at Aintree (3m, soft) in April 2023; just three starts since for this 10yo, who showed in two beginners' chases last month that he retains a good chunk of his ability; the likely danger to Wendigo but has something to find with that rival; cheekpieces go on.

runners.comment: Won at Kelso last month; further improvement needed to defy a penalty in this better race
runners.name: Cavalier du Luy
runners.spotlight: Point winner (3m, good) who went close on hurdle debut over C&D (soft) in November before going one better at Kelso (2m, good to soft); can give another good account but further improvement is needed if he's to defy a penalty in this better race.

runners.comment: Defied mammoth absence for 25-1 win at Southwell; this is tougher, but a likeable prospect
runners.name: Irandando Has
runners.owner: The Late John Hales And Miss L Hales
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on debut in Listed 3yo hurdle in France (2m2f, very soft) in 2022 and returned from mammoth absence to win at 25-1 at Southwell (2m, good to soft) last month on first run for Sam Allwood; tough task today under a penalty but he's a likeable prospect, provided things keep going to plan.

runners.comment: Non-runner

runners.comment: Made it 2-2 here when winning over C&D last time and he may well have more to offer

runners.spotlight: Course bumper winner who tapped back into that promise and made it 2-2 here when winning over C&D (soft) four weeks ago on his third hurdle start; carries a penalty in a warmer race today but he may well have more to offer.

runners.comment: Won at Tramore on New Year's Day and holds leading claims under his 7lb penalty
runners.name: Stede Bonnet
runners.spotlight: Two-time bumper winner who was second to smart prospect over C&D (heavy) last month before going one better at Tramore (2m1f, soft) on New Year's Day, when clear with the odds-on favourite; leading claims under penalty.

runners.comment: Hasn't shown much across his four starts and tailed off at 300-1 over C&D last time

runners.comment: Point winner who also showed promise on sole hurdle start and could be in the mix
runners.name: Irish Champ
runners.spotlight: Won on debut in Irish maiden point (3m, yielding to soft) in November and faded into fourth of 11 in maiden hurdle at Leopardstown (2m4f, good to yielding) last month, beaten just over 14l; this drop in trip may be a suitable move for the time being and he could be in the mix.

runners.comment: Pulled up at massive odds over C&D (soft) on first two starts; cheekpieces go on
runners.name: Run Baby Run
runners.spotlight: Pulled up at massive odds over C&D (soft) on first two starts and a transformation is needed in first-time cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Point winner; things should click under rules at some point but tailed off in sole bumper
runners.name: Valtteri Its James

15:13.race_name: Coral Racing Club 'Join For Free' Handicap Hurdle (Go North Brindisi Breeze Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Reverts to hurdles following wind op and off same mark as for win in this code last April

runners.comment: Step back in the right direction last time and not discounted now back down in grade

runners.comment: Retains potential for staying trips and he could jump better now in cheekpieces

runners.spotlight: Lacked fluency and disappointing when upped in trip at Uttoxeter (2m7f, soft) last month; however, prior to that he stayed on well for third at Wetherby (2m5f, soft) and he could jump better now in cheekpieces; this lightly raced 7yo retains potential for staying trips.

runners.comment: Won first two handicaps (including C&D) before good third at Ascot; he's a solid candidate

runners.spotlight: Won in November on first two handicap starts (soft; including C&D) and another good run when third at Ascot (2m7f, good to soft) last month; remains open to further improvement and he's a solid candidate for last year's winning yard; wears first-time cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Not at the top of her game this season but showed some appealing form here last spring
runners.name: Foxs Fancy

runners.comment: Went close in this last year and now 10lb lower but has struggled to get competitive since
runners.name: Gaillimh A Stor

runners.comment: 11yo whose mark continues to fall but for good reason; well beaten on both runs this term
runners.name: Theme Tune

runners.name: Canunclecani
runners.spotlight: 3m point runner-up who has also shown promise in novice hurdles; he's hinted this step up in trip could be a good move on handicap debut and he's one to consider.

runners.comment: Three-time course winner, the latest over C&D 16 days ago; could be thereabouts up 4lb

runners.spotlight: 10yo who made it 3-9 at Ayr when winning over C&D (heavy) 16 days ago; remains feasibly treated back up 4lb and could be thereabouts.

runners.name: Adveram
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent but returned to form with a win when back over hurdles at Hexham (2m7f, heavy) last month; he has a solid record here and could be in the mix up just 3lb for last time.

runners.breeder: Earl Trinquet M Trinquet & O Trinquet

runners.name: Grand Voyage
runners.spotlight: Two-time hurdle winner who is 5lb lower than when winning over fences here last March; however, this 10yo has been unable to threaten across his five starts since, back over hurdles on the last two occasions.

runners.spotlight: Won twice in a row last March (2m4f/2m1f, good/good to soft); also effective on soft ground; pulled up at Kelso last April when last seen but he goes well fresh and might not be far away on his comeback.

runners.spotlight: He needs to produce more than he's managed on his first three chase starts but this lightly raced 6yo is in top hands and could take a sizeable step forward at some point.

runners.comment: Two wins from his last three starts (including C&D) and he's entitled to respect
runners.name: Ballyfort
runners.spotlight: Won when back over fences at Kelso (2m1f, good) in October on his reappearance and back on the scoresheet over this C&D (soft) four weeks ago; had just three rivals to beat last time and he's up 3lb in a deeper race today, but he's clearly in good heart and is entitled to respect.

runners.comment: 10yo who isn't the force of old but was runner-up off this reduced mark last month

runners.spotlight: 10yo who isn't the force of old but has dropped down the weights accordingly and finished second to an improving winner at Musselburgh last month; could be a contender if backing up that performance.

runners.spotlight: Belied 33-1 odds when third of seven on debut at Carlisle (2m1f, soft) two months ago, and the runner-up has since gone one better; open to improvement himself and he's one to consider.

runners.name: Myfriendcooper

runners.name: Bang On The Bell

runners.name: Level Up
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; generally run okay since his Chelmsford win last October (5f) and he is now 2lb lower; well drawn but might find one or two stronger once again.

runners.name: Alafdhal

runners.name: Son Of Astar

runners.name: Captain Kinsella

runners.comment: Improved to win a C&D maiden three weeks ago; unexposed but opening mark demands more
runners.name: Space Invasion

runners.comment: Second of four on recent AW debut; dropped 2lb and headgear is now given a go
runners.name: Try Storm Cat

runners.comment: Bolted up in a weak maiden at Wolverhampton this month; should remain competitive
runners.name: Sovereign Wealth
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the eighth attempt when streaking clear of six rivals at Wolverhampton 23 days ago (8.6f); not sure he needed to improve to win that modest affair (2-9 favourite) but earlier Wolverhampton second showed he could compete off this sort of mark.

runners.comment: Won two of her six starts but not at best last time and needs the new trip to spark extra
runners.name: Luminare
runners.spotlight: The winner of two of her six starts; seemingly held on merit at Southwell four weeks ago (7f) and hopes rest on the step up to 1m sparking extra.

runners.name: Maskatto
runners.spotlight: Kept on well to wear down Foothold close home over C&D four weeks ago, his first run at the trip; should have more to offer and can confirm those placings despite the 1lb worse terms.

runners.name: Foothold
runners.spotlight: Improved for the step up to 1m when collared late on by Maskatto here 26 days ago; beaten at odds-on when second over 7f here last week; not ruled out now making his handicap debut.

runners.name: Celtic John

runners.name: Charles Morin

runners.name: Unknown Journey

runners.name: Sullivan Bay
runners.spotlight: Both wins were at this track (1m6f/2m) in 2024 but last of ten at Kempton (2m, AW) when last seen 218 days ago; returns on a handy mark and with the visor back, replacing the blinkers of last three outings; considered.

runners.comment: Three-time winner but he's been struggling in recent starts; others preferred
runners.name: Alex The Great
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner, with the most recent of those wins coming at Newcastle (2m, AW) last March off 7lb higher than today, but he's been struggling in recent starts; others preferred.

runners.comment: Won on the Flat in 2022 and over hurdles in 2024, but well beaten on recent stable debut
runners.name: Shibuya Song
runners.spotlight: Won a 1m4f Flat handicap for Ed Walker in July 2022 and over hurdles in September 2024 for Richard Phillips; well beaten at Southwell (1m6f, AW; 20-1) on stable debut nine days ago and needs to leave that effort well behind.

runners.spotlight: Ended a long losing spell with a 1m5f success here in August but well held in her three starts since, including over this trip at Lingfield 12 days ago.

runners.comment: Seven-time winner over hurdles but 0-10 on the AW; behind Taranjerine at Lingfield latest
runners.name: Hiconic
runners.spotlight: Seven-time winner over hurdles but 0-12 on Flat (0-10 on the AW); ran respectably when fourth of nine at Wolverhampton (2m, AW) last month but she was behind Taranjerine at Lingfield 22 days ago; others preferred.

runners.name: H Key Lails

runners.name: Straight A

runners.name: Gennadius

runners.breeder: Brook Stud Bloodstock & W A Tinkler

runners.name: Lady Justice

runners.comment: Off the mark at Kempton latest; up in grade off 6lb higher mark; could have more to offer
runners.name: Luminous Warrior
runners.spotlight: Off the mark when narrowly coming out on top at Kempton (1m, AW) 43 days ago; up in grade off a 6lb higher mark but he hasn't been with this yard for that long and could have more to offer.
